authorization: User explicitly approved allowing zero bone-animation scale according to actual Cane exports, retaining non-zero setup bone and Region rules, and adding regressions.

specification.previousRule: Scale values are finite and non-zero when applied.
specification.rule: Bone animation scale values are finite and may be zero or negative. A zero animated scale produces its singular affine matrix; it is not replaced by epsilon or setup scale. Setup bone scales remain non-zero.

acceptanceRule: Only current-source successful two-fresh-process evidence establishes native regression coverage; this clarification does not certify a complete Core or an engine adapter.
